description.en: A Feishu (Lark) workbench view for DeepSeek Harness: connection status, quick notes into a wiki doc, drive & wiki browsing, file upload.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书工作台视图：接入状态、速记直达知识库文档、云空间与知识库浏览、文件上传，都收在一张卡片里。

pluginDescription.en: See Feishu status at a glance, jot quick notes into your wiki notebook, browse wiki spaces and drive files, create docs and bases, upload attachments.
pluginDescription.zh: 顶栏一键打开：看飞书接入状态、写速记自动进知识库速记本、浏览知识库与云空间、新建文档和多维表格、上传附件。
